    Peptides vs steroids: what each one is, and what the law says.

    Peptide Chooser editorial team. Checked 30 Oct 2026.

    Short answer

    Anabolic steroids are man-made versions of testosterone. Doctors prescribe them for some medical problems, and using them without a prescription is not legal.1 The peptides sold for muscle, such as CJC-1295 and ipamorelin, are research-use products that make the body release more growth hormone; none is FDA approved for building muscle.2 We found no trial in people that shows any of them builds muscle.

    What is the difference between a peptide and a steroid?

    They are different kinds of substance. Anabolic steroids are man-made versions of testosterone, the main sex hormone in men, which helps build muscle.1

    A peptide is a short chain of amino acids. The peptides sold for muscle work on a different signal: they make the body release more growth hormone. CJC-1295 is a long-acting copy of the hormone that tells the body to release it,3 and ipamorelin acts on a different receptor with the same aim.4

    Which of them are FDA approved?

    Steroids: doctors prescribe anabolic steroids for some hormone problems in men, for delayed puberty and for muscle loss from some diseases.1 Testosterone is FDA approved only for men with low testosterone from a medical condition, on prescription after blood tests.5 Our sexual health page lists it.

    Peptides: no peptide is FDA approved for building muscle. Tesamorelin is approved to reduce belly fat in adults with HIV and lipodystrophy, and growth hormone itself (somatropin) mainly for growth hormone deficiency.67 Drugs@FDA lists no approved product for CJC-1295 or ipamorelin.2

    Is it legal to buy them?

    Steroids: using them in a way a provider did not prescribe, without a prescription, is not legal, MedlinePlus says.1 The FDA has found bodybuilding products sold online and in stores as "dietary supplements" that illegally contain steroids or steroid-like substances.8

    Peptides: shops sell CJC-1295 and ipamorelin as research-use vials, labelled for lab research and not for people. That label does not make them approved or checked.9 Our guide Are peptides legal in the US? explains each kind.

    What has been tested in people?

    For steroids, MedlinePlus lists the medical uses above, under a provider's care.1

    For the muscle peptides, hormone levels, not muscle. In two placebo-controlled trials in healthy adults, CJC-1295 raised growth hormone and IGF-I; the trials did not measure muscle or strength.3 Ipamorelin's one larger trial in people was in 117 patients after bowel surgery, where it did no better than a placebo.10

    What are the risks of each?

    Steroids: misuse, above all over a long time, is linked to acne, high blood pressure, changes in cholesterol, heart problems including heart attack, liver disease including cancer, kidney damage, and mood changes such as aggression. In men it can shrink the testicles and lower sperm count; in women it can deepen the voice and change the menstrual cycle. Steroids can also lead to addiction, with withdrawal symptoms such as depression.1 The FDA has reports of serious liver injury linked to bodybuilding products with steroids or steroid-like substances.8

    Peptides: the FDA lists serious side effects linked to CJC-1295, including a faster heart rate, and says the data in people are limited. For ipamorelin it says a published study found serious side effects, including a death, when it was given into a vein for gut problems.11 Nobody checks what is in a research-use vial; a lab report covers one batch. Our guide on how to read a COA shows what to look for.

    So which should you choose?

    Neither has evidence in people that it builds muscle safely in healthy adults: steroid misuse is linked to the health problems above, and the muscle peptides have no muscle trial in people. If you think your testosterone is low, a doctor can test it and decide whether you have a condition they treat.

    None of this is medical advice. Our muscle page puts the options side by side with their status.

    Questions about peptides vs steroids

    What is the difference between peptides and steroids?

    Anabolic steroids are man-made versions of testosterone. The peptides sold for muscle are short chains of amino acids that make the body release more growth hormone.

    Are steroids legal?

    Doctors prescribe anabolic steroids for some medical problems. Using them without a prescription is not legal, MedlinePlus says.

    Is any peptide FDA approved for building muscle?

    No. Drugs@FDA lists no approved product for CJC-1295 or ipamorelin, and the approved growth hormone medicines are for medical conditions.

    Are peptides safer than steroids?

    Neither has evidence in people that it builds muscle safely in healthy adults. Steroid misuse is linked to heart, liver and kidney problems; the FDA lists serious side effects linked to CJC-1295 and ipamorelin.
